The 89.3 (underlined) appears one row down, in the MMBench-CN row. 88.9 appears in the RealWorldQA row, and 79.2 one row below that. The instruct values all seem shifted down a row, so the intended layout is probably:
  - MMBench-EN: 89.3
  - MMBench-CN: 88.9
  - RealWorldQA: 79.2

  This matches the order in the prose.

On the same reading, the thinking variant scores 88.8 on MMBench-EN (p. 15). Because the table is malformed, you should check the original PDF's Table 2 to confirm 89.3 belongs to EN rather than CN.
